title: cynoglossum virginianum var. boreale
intro: Cynoglossum virginianum var. boreale, commonly known as Northern Hound's Tongue, is a flowering plant that belongs to the borage family and is native to North America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Northern Hound's Tongue include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. Bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, saponins, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
